subject: Staged uptake, evaluation gates & pricing schedule
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika@novashift.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged uptake, evaluation gates & pricing schedule

Hi Anika —

Great to speak earlier. As promised, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft SOW to align on timelines and commercial milestones for your evaluation and planned production ramp. High-level proposed cadence: 

- Week 0–4: Evaluation (POC) — access to hosted API + 50k test tokens/day simulated load; weekly checkpoints.
- Month 1 (post-eval): Pilot month — commit 1.0M tokens (baseline rate).
- Month 2: 2.5M tokens (ramp-up).
- Month 3–6: steady-state cadence to reach 10M tokens/month by month 6.

Pricing & commercial triggers (proposal):
- Base unit price: $0.0008 / token for hosted API usage.
- Milestone discount: 12% applied once committed monthly tokens >= 5M.
- Volume rebate: additional 3% for hitting cumulative 50M tokens within 90 days.

We recommend milestone-based credits for regressions during model swaps and a short burst credit (two days) to support the initial migration. Draft MAP (MAP-NovaShift-v1.xlsx) includes explicit evaluation success criteria, test prompt sets, and responsibilities.

Questions for you:
1) Does the proposed 6-month ramp to 10M/month match your expected product timeline?
2) Any procurement constraints on commit cadence or billing cadence we should know about?
3) Will SOC2 evidence be required for internal security sign-off (I included the SOC2-summary.pdf for reference)?

If this looks broadly aligned I can loop in our sales leadership to approve the milestone discount path and generate a DocuSign SOW.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0176

Attachments: MAP-NovaShift-v1.xlsx (xlsx), SOW-NovaShift-draft.docx (docx), SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Anika Shah <anika@novashift.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaShift Procurement <procurement@novashift.ai>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged uptake, evaluation gates & pricing schedule

Thanks, Kimberly — appreciate the clear plan and attachments. A few notes from our side after running the POC checklist with engineering: 

- Evaluation window: we can do 4 weeks but need two additional integration checkpoints (week 1 + week 3) focused on tokenization differences and latency at prepended context sizes.
- Ramp ask: our finance team wants a gentler ramp on committed TPMs — can we shift to 1.0M (month 1), 1.8M (month 2), 3.5M (month 3), 6M (month 4), 8M (month 5), 10M (month 6)?
- Discount triggers: procurement is pushing for the 12% discount to start at 6M/month instead of 5M. They also asked whether the rebate can be applied quarterly instead of a 90-day cumulative window.

We can share formal procurement language if helpful. Happy to jump on a quick call Tuesday to finalize.

—Anika
Head of AI Platforms, NovaShift
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Staged uptake, evaluation gates & pricing schedule — counter framing

Kim / Marissa —

Summarizing Anika's procurement asks and proposing a counter that preserves target economics but meets their cadence: 

Customer asks: 
- Shift ramp: 1.0M / 1.8M / 3.5M / 6M / 8M / 10M (months 1–6)
- Move discount trigger to 6M/month; rebate applied quarterly

Proposed Redwood response (keep ASP but adjust triggers):
- Accept the revised monthly ramp sequence.
- Discount: Start at 10% at 6M/month (instead of our 12% at 5M).
- Rebate: convert to quarterly reconciliation — if cumulative tokens in quarter >= 30M we apply a 3% rebate to that quarter's invoice.
- Early-burst credit: keep one 48-hour migration credit; add one-time onboarding credit of $8k applied to first invoice if the customer signs SOW within 10 business days.

Why this works: preserves near-term unit economics, adds an onboarding concession that is low-cost to us but high-value to NovaShift, and aligns with procurement's quarterly preference.

Asks: 
- Marissa / Kimberly: Do we need VP approval to go to 10% at 6M? My read is yes (since this is > standard discount band). If yes, recommend we fast-track to Vivek for approval and lock the DocuSign link with these terms.

Ben
Senior Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Staged uptake, evaluation gates & pricing schedule — approval request

Vivek — forwarding Ben's counter (below). Quick summary: NovaShift wants a slower ramp but asks to move the discount trigger to 6M/month. Ben recommends we accept the ramp and offer a 10% discount at 6M with a quarterly 3% rebate if they hit 30M/quarter, plus an $8k onboarding credit if they sign quickly.

This is a strategic account — top-of-funnel expansion potential. Approving the 10% concession unlocks the deal runway; the onboarding credit is within deal desk tolerances. Would you sign off so we can finalize the SOW and send DocuSign?

Key risks to note: if they under-index in months 3–4 we need an SLA on smoothing to avoid long unpaid tail. I propose we add a one-time extension clause in the MAP to allow a single calendar-month adjustment.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Staged uptake, evaluation gates & pricing schedule — approval request

Team —

Approve the proposed concessions: 10% discount at 6M/month, quarterly 3% rebate on 30M/quarter attainment, and the $8k one-time onboarding credit. Please ensure the following before DocuSign: 
1) MAP includes a single-month smoothing clause (one-time use) tied to documented outage or integration delay.
2) Add a clause limiting the onboarding credit to non-recoupable professional services (so it doesn't become an ongoing credit line).
3) Legal to add standard termination for convenience with 30-day notice and prorated billing.

Once Legal signs off on the SOW language, send DocuSign to Anika and procurement and copy me. Close timeline: target signature within 10 business days to secure the onboarding credit.

—Vivek
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika@novashift.ai>, NovaShift Procurement <procurement@novashift.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final MAP & commercial terms for signature (DocuSign link included)

Anika — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping procurement. We reviewed your ramp and procurement requests and have the following final proposal for signature: 

1) Ramp schedule (months 1–6): 1.0M / 1.8M / 3.5M / 6M / 8M / 10M committed tokens per month.
2) Unit price: $0.0008 / token (hosted plan).
3) Milestone discount: 10% applied to invoices starting the month the committed monthly tokens >= 6M.
4) Rebate: quarterly 3% rebate applied if quarter cumulative tokens >= 30M.
5) Credits: one 48-hour migration credit + $8,000 one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice if SOW signed within 10 business days of this email.
6) Evaluation gates: success criteria as listed in MAP-NovaShift-v1.xlsx — must be met during the 4-week evaluation to proceed to pilot. Integration checkpoints at week 1 and week 3.
7) Operational clause: one-time calendar-month smoothing allowance for missed ramp due to integration or outage, documented in MAP.

Attached are the final MAP and revised SOW for signature. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/containers/abc123-NovaShift-MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/NSH-2026-031

If these terms look good I'll send the DocuSign envelope to Anika and procurement. Target: signed SOW by 2026-06-16 to secure the onboarding credit.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
